# Bucksworth Home Services

> Arizona's trusted home services company providing pest control, air conditioning, heating, plumbing, water heaters, weed control, and lawn care across Phoenix and Tucson metro areas. Family-owned since 2013. AZ ROC #343924. Google Guaranteed.

## Company Overview

Bucksworth Home Services is a family-owned home services company founded in 2013 by Jordan and Taylor Moore, serving 33 cities across Phoenix and Tucson, Arizona. We specialize in pest and termite control, air conditioning and heating, plumbing and water heaters, and weed and lawn care.

- Phone (Phoenix): (480) 422-8388
- Phone (Tucson): (520) 284-9930
- Website: https://getyourbucksworth.com
- Service Area: Phoenix Metro (24 cities), Tucson Metro (9 cities)
- Licenses: AZ ROC #343924, AG License #9613
- Reviews: 4.84 stars, 50+ Google reviews, 100% reply rate
